name: Toolweather
description: Is this MCP server healthy and safe to call now? Live checks of ~2,000 servers + alternatives. Also checks AI/dev API status and model deprecations.
author: toolweather

tools.name: check_mcp_server_health
tools.title: Is this MCP server healthy / safe to call right now?
tools.description: Check if a remote MCP server (by registry name or URL), and optionally one specific tool on it, is up, healthy and safe to call right now. Use BEFORE adding or calling a third-party MCP server, or after its calls fail/time out, to decide: call it, call with care, or switch to an alternative. Covers ~2,000 public servers from the official MCP registry, probed every 15 min; results older than 5 min are re-verified with a live handshake. Returns a one-line summary first, then verdict (safe | caution | unsafe | unknown), recommended_action, reasons, latency, auth requirement, last breaking tool change, checked_at and freshness. Example: {"server":"com.ufcalendar/fight-api","tool":"search"}. Alias: is_safe_to_call.

server.description: MCP server registry name (e.g. io.github.owner/name, com.example/server) or its remote URL (https://.../mcp). Partial names are matched.

tool.description: Optional tool name to confirm it still exists on the server, e.g. search

fresh.description: Force a live handshake now (otherwise automatic when the stored check is >5 min old)

bearer_token.description: Optional: your own token for this server, for a one-off authenticated initialize + tools/list check. Used once, never stored or logged.

tools.name: find_alternative_mcp_servers
tools.title: Find a working MCP server that does X
tools.description: Find healthy, currently-working MCP servers by capability (e.g. 'send email', 'web search', 'postgres') or replacements for a broken server (pass its name/URL). Use when check_mcp_server_health says unsafe, or when you need a tool you don't have. Unhealthy servers are excluded. Returns summary first, then ranked servers with verdict, latency and matching tools. Example: {"query":"send email","limit":5}. Alias: suggest_alternatives.

query.description: Capability text like 'send email', or a server name/URL to replace

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.title: Get a free Toolweather API key
tools.description: Get a free Toolweather API key instantly (1,000 calls/day, 3 watches). Optional: call health tools with no key (50/day anonymous). No email or signup. The key is shown once; pass it as the X-API-Key header or the api_key argument.

tools.name: watch_server
tools.title: Alert me when an MCP server breaks
tools.description: Get an HTTPS webhook when an MCP server goes down, its verdict changes (safe/caution/unsafe), it starts requiring auth, or its tool list has a breaking change. Use instead of polling. Returns a per-watch secret for verifying the X-Toolweather-Signature header. Free tier: 3 watches per key. Example: {"server":"com.ufcalendar/fight-api","webhook_url":"https://example.com/hook"}.

server.description: MCP server registry name (e.g. io.github.owner/name, com.example/server) or its remote URL (https://.../mcp). Partial names are matched.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL that receives POSTed JSON alerts

tools.name: list_watches
tools.title: List my server watches
tools.description: List this API key's server watches and their webhook delivery health.

tools.name: unwatch_server
tools.title: Stop watching a server
tools.description: Delete one of your watches by id (from list_watches).

tools.name: check_api_status
tools.title: Is this API / provider down right now?
tools.description: Check if an AI or developer API provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, GitHub, Stripe, Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase, Twilio... ~40 total) is up, degraded or down right now. Use BEFORE calling a provider's API, or right after you get 5xx/429/timeout errors, to decide whether to retry, wait or switch to a fallback. Returns a one-line summary first, then verdict, recommended_action, open incidents, affected components, checked_at and freshness (checked every ~4 min). Example: {"provider":"openai"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.003 via x402 (USDC on Base). Alias: get_status. Part of the Toolweather suite (Upstream).

provider.description: Provider id (lowercase). Examples: openai, anthropic, google-ai, mistral, groq, github, stripe, cloudflare. Full list: list_providers.

tools.name: check_model_deprecation
tools.title: Is this model deprecated, and what replaces it?
tools.description: Check if an LLM model id is active, deprecated or retired, its shutdown date, and the recommended replacement, from the provider's own deprecation page (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.). Use before hard-coding or calling a model, or when a model call fails with "model not found / deprecated". Returns summary first, then verdict, recommended_action (keep_using | plan_migration | switch_now | verify_with_provider), replacement, shutdown_date, evidence rows and freshness. Example: {"model":"gpt-4-0613"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.003 via x402. Alias: get_model (param "id"). Part of the Toolweather suite (Upstream).

model.description: Model id as used in the API call. Examples: gpt-4o, claude-3-opus-20240229, gemini-1.5-pro.

tools.name: list_recent_api_changes
tools.title: What changed recently in AI/dev APIs?
tools.description: List recent breaking or notable changes across AI and developer APIs: outages and recoveries, deprecation-page edits, model retirements and pricing-page edits. Use to answer "did anything change that could break my integration?" or to explain sudden errors. Returns summary first, then the change list with timestamps and source links. Example: {"provider":"anthropic","kind":"model_retirement"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.01 via x402. Alias: get_changes. Part of the Toolweather suite (Upstream).

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; default 7 days ago. Example: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

tools.name: list_providers
tools.title: List tracked API providers
tools.description: List the ~40 AI and developer API providers Upstream tracks with their current state (operational/degraded/outage) and checked_at. Use to find the right provider id for check_api_status, or for a quick all-providers health overview. Free. Part of the Toolweather suite (Upstream).

tools.name: get_digest
tools.title: Daily AI/dev API breaking-changes digest
tools.description: Daily digest (free) of AI/dev API incidents, model deprecations/retirements, pricing-page changes and breaking MCP server changes. Use for a once-a-day catch-up instead of polling. Example: {} for the latest, or {"date":"2026-10-14"}. Part of the Toolweather suite (Upstream).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest issue
